english.title: Contravention of a building control stop notice
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were a person to whom a stop notice had been given under section 35C of the Building Act 1984 and which had been contravened in that **(..SPECIFY CONTRAVENTION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 35C(4) and (5) of the Building Act 1984.

english.notes: Section 35C(6) of the Building Act 1984 provides a defence of due diligence.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and/or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

In either case, liable on summary conviction to a further fine not exceeding level 1 on the standard scale for each day on which the default continues after the initial conviction.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.
